name: Analytics
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Privacy-friendly analytics: Plausible, Umami, or GoatCounter.

name: Breadcrumbs
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Shows the note's folder path above its title.

name: Copy Code Button
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Adds a copy button to every code block.

name: Garden Stats
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: A sidebar widget with your garden's vital signs: note count, link count, and the most-linked notes.

name: Giscus Comments
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: GitHub-Discussions-backed comments under every note, powered by giscus.app.

name: Growth Stages
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Shows each note's maturity as a growth stage: seedling, budding, or evergreen. Set it with growth: seedling in a note's frontmatter.

name: Hello Gardener
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: A tiny test plugin: shows a friendly badge under every note. Try the install flow with it.

name: Image Lightbox
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Click any image in a note to view it full size in an overlay.

name: MOC Navigation
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Replaces the file tree with a Map of Content grown from your home note's links.

name: Note Age Banner
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Warns readers when a note hasn't been tended for a while.

name: Random Note Button
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: A dice button in the navigation that jumps to a random note.

name: Recently Tended
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: A list of your most recently updated notes on the home page.

name: Related Notes
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Suggests related notes under each note, based on the link graph neighborhood.

name: Tag Navigation
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Replaces the file tree with navigation grouped by tags.

name: Webmentions
author: Ole Eskild Steensen
description: Shows likes, reposts, and replies from around the web under your notes, via webmention.io.
